scope: Reconcile verified inverse-executor preconditions with one-operation dispatch and authoritative reread state transitions only.
finding: M673 verifies canonical authorization, manifest, and permit digests plus claim/permit digest equality, but no executor composes those checks. The manifest records only a self-consistent lexical observation list: it does not prove exact inverse-plan operation or payload correspondence and does not carry reverseDependencyOrder. The claim store returns the candidate after write without a post-write load, and the boundary exposes no state-transition method. The inverse adapter has generic delete/restore results and a readback shape, but no operation-specific outcome classifier or terminal receipt persistence boundary.
selectedNext: M675 code-only: add pure exact manifest-to-plan/reverse-order validation and operation-specific inverse outcome, authoritative-reread, terminal-receipt, and retry-state contracts; no dispatch.
